changes.historical_text: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that includes the effect of destroying 1 Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.
changes.modern_text: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field (and no other cards) and would destroy it: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.
